items.title: Michael Moore interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: As a trio, with Ron McCurdy, a drummer who lived there.

ctx.x: As a trio, with Ron McCurdy, a drummer who lived there. And it was the best job, to this day, that I’ve ever had. And it was playing jazz five hours a night with a great group and bunnies to look at and great food. And I thought the music business is wonderful. And I didn’t know it was going to be steadily downhill from there. And then that came to an end, that job came to an end and I thought well I mean it’s back to the same cycle of clubs and stuff in Cincinnati. And I figured well it’s time to move to New…
When you look at the Local 802 union book, you see an awful lot of players. And what was it like, trying to find a niche?
